title: Ufff..Yeh Love Hai Mushkil
summary: Ufff..Yeh Love Hai Mushkil  (transl. Ugh... This Love Is Difficult) is an Indian Hindi-language comedy-drama television series that aired from 9 June 2025 to 4 October 2025 on Sony SAB and digitally on SonyLIV. It is produced by Aamir Jaffar and Sonali Jaffar under Full House Media Films, starring Shabbir Ahluwalia and Ashi Singh.
plot:
Yug Sinha, a sharp yet emotionally distant lawyer, has lost faith in love following a painful betrayal. His life takes a dramatic turn when he crosses paths with Kairi Sharma, a spirited young woman juggling multiple jobs while raising her three younger siblings — Biscuit, Imarti, and Gujiya.
Yug and Kairi immediately clash because of their opposing worldviews — he is practical and guarded, while she is hopeful and guided by her heart. Their constant run-ins, both at home and in the courtroom, lead to a series of emotional confrontations and comic misunderstandings.
Despite their differences, a deeper bond gradually develops as both are forced to confront their pasts and support their families through personal and legal struggles. Their relationship becomes even more complicated with the return of Lata, Yug's mysterious ex-wife, who brings unresolved emotions and hidden motives.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Shabir Ahluwalia as Advocate Yug Sinha – Shaurya , Shlok and Samay's brother; Lata's ex-husband; Kairi's husband. * Ashi Singh as Kairi Sharma Sinha – Mairi's younger daughter; Kundan's step-daughter; Lata's sister; Biscuit, Imarti, and Gujiya's step-sister; Yug's wife.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The series uses AI to depict younger avatars of characters for backstory and narrative depth. AI is used to de-age the character of Yug Sinha for flashback sequences. Instead of using a different actor to play the younger version, AI technology is employed to digitally alter lead actor Shabir Ahluwalia's appearance, making him look younger.

episodesList.title: Galati
episodesList.summary: Meet Advocate Yug Sinha - a brilliant, brooding lawyer who lives in Delhi with his three brothers and carries a burning disdain for women, rooted in a past shrouded in mystery and betrayal.

episodesList.title: Raste Apne Aap Khul Jayenge
episodesList.summary: Kairi Sharma attempts to meet Yug Sinha but is chased out by his dog. Later, Kairi finds a way to enter Yug's house and soon comes face-to-face with Yug Sinha.

episodesList.title: Kairi Vs Yug
episodesList.summary: Kairi and Yug clash in a court case. She succeeds in turning the case in her favour.

episodesList.title: Kairi Receives A Notice
episodesList.summary: Yug arrives outside Kairi's residence and delivers her a notice. Yug's move presents another challenge before Kairi and her family.

episodesList.title: Yug's Drastic Steps
episodesList.summary: Kairi and Yug receive a call from each of their brothers. They end up face to face in the principal's cabin, where Yug decides to make his brother repeat a year for his mistake.

episodesList.title: Maeri Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Yug returns injured. Maeri recalls Lata upon seeing a chain in his hand. She then goes missing, searching for Lata, and meets Kairi. What is the connection between Lata and Kairi?

episodesList.title: Shifting To Yug's House
episodesList.summary: Kairi and her family move in with Yug and his family. Soon after, chaos breaks in the household.

episodesList.title: Property Mein Hissa
episodesList.summary: Yug asks Kairi and her family to shift to the outhouse. Soon after, he makes his brothers sign some property papers.

episodesList.title: Shlok Ka Sapna
episodesList.summary: Kairi overhears Shlok talking to an agent who would help him migrate illegally to London. Soon after, she gets the agent arrested.

episodesList.title: Yug Ke Ghar Mein Chori
episodesList.summary: Kairi attempts to get into Yug's room to steal Shlok's documents, as her way of repentance. Soon after, she witnesses a thief running away from Yug's office.

episodesList.title: Kairi Receives Another Notice
episodesList.summary: Kairi's stepfather gives her the news that he is going to court to fight for the custody rights of his children. Soon after, the police arrive at Yug's house to arrest the thief who stole Yug's documents.

episodesList.title: Kairi's Gift For Yug
episodesList.summary: When Kairi thanks Yug for defending her brother, he reacts coldly. As her step siblings confront her, will they be forced to leave Yug's house?

episodesList.title: Yug Offers Kairi A Job
episodesList.summary: Yug offers Kairi an internship. Soon after, while Kairi is given a task by Yug, she finds out about her case in court.

episodesList.title: Pehle Jaisi Maeri
episodesList.summary: Kairi attends her court hearing, after which, she receives another job offer. Later, Kairi returns home and helps Maeri dress up.

episodesList.title: Maeri Ki Khushi
episodesList.summary: Kairi defends Maeri before all the people at the event. Yug decides to confront Kairi but changes his mind when he sees Maeri's happiness.

episodesList.title: Yug Burns Lata's Saree
episodesList.summary: Yug loses his calm on seeing Kairi in Lata's saree. Soon after, he tries to console Maeri.

episodesList.title: Imarti Is Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: On being ill-treated by Yug, Kairi decides to take up the job offered by Yug's rival. Later, Imarti gets kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Yug's Case Weakens
episodesList.summary: Vikram presents arguments in court that weaken Yug's case. Can Yug still secure victory for his client?

episodesList.title: The Hunt For Imarti
episodesList.summary: Yug rescues Kairi from the pit, and later informs him about Imarti's call. Soon after, they set out to look for her.

episodesList.title: Yug Assures Kairi
episodesList.summary: Yug assures Kairi that they'd find Imarti. Later, Kairi realises that it was her father who had plotted Imarti's kidnapping.

episodesList.title: Yug Punishes His Brothers
episodesList.summary: Yug helps Biscuit deal with his fear. Later, Kairi asks Yug to stop pursuing the investigation of Imarti's kidnapping.

episodesList.title: Kundan Reunites With His Children
episodesList.summary: Kundan reunites with Gujiya, who insists on him coming over to meet Imarti and Biscuit. Soon after, Yug overhears Kairi's conversation with Kundan and loses his calm.

episodesList.title: Kundan Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Yug files a complaint against Kundan and asks the police to kidnap him. At the police station, the children find out about Kundan having conspired Imarti's kidnapping.

episodesList.title: Kairi Finds Strength
episodesList.summary: When Kairi's step-siblings turn against her, a voice message gives her strength. As Yug confronts Kundan in jail, Kairi puts on an act to win her siblings back. Will it work?

episodesList.title: Kairi Attempts To Get Her Job Back
episodesList.summary: Biscuit requests Kairi to let their father be in jail. Soon after, Kairi goes to Yug and requests him to give her her job back.

episodesList.title: Maeri's Blackmail
episodesList.summary: The entire family is shocked to see Yug and Kairi in the morning. Soon after, Kairi reenters Yug's room to look for her phone, where Maeri blackmails her and Yug.

episodesList.title: Kairi Goes Through The Cassettes
episodesList.summary: After talking to Yug and getting her job back successfully, Kairi goes through some of the cassettes and finds a phone number.

episodesList.title: Kairi Wishes To Meet Mr Majnu
episodesList.summary: Kairi asks Mr Majnu to meet her at a cafe. Gujiya and Shaurya overhear their respective step-siblings and reach the cafe before them.

episodesList.title: Action Against Yug
episodesList.summary: Yug's advocate license is in jeopardy of being revoked. Yug believes Kairi is responsible for the video that got leaked.

episodesList.title: Proof Against Vikram
episodesList.summary: As Kairi rushes to present the evidence in court that could save Yug, Vikram does everything he can to stop her. Will she make it in time?

episodesList.title: Kairi Saves Yug's Career
episodesList.summary: Kairi provides proof against Mr Malhotra. Meanwhile, Kairi's family has been worrying about her safety, as they watch the news on TV.

episodesList.title: Yug Snatches Kairi's Card
episodesList.summary: Before Kairi gets a chance to read the name written on the back, Yug snatches the card and tears it to pieces. Later, Kairi prays dearly to get a chance to meet Mr Majnu.

episodesList.title: Maeri Slaps Kairi
episodesList.summary: Kairi follows Mr Majnu and catches up to him. Soon after, Maeri, angered by Kairi's remarks, slaps her and then falls down the stairs in an attempt to put distance between them.

episodesList.title: Kairi Donates Blood
episodesList.summary: Kairi overhears Yug's conversation with the doctor and finds out some shocking news. Shortly after, she donates blood to Maeri.

episodesList.title: Kairi Consoles Yug
episodesList.summary: Kairi consoles Yug. Soon after, Maeri regains consciousness and has a sudden recollection of an old memory.

episodesList.title: Dil Tootne Ka Case
episodesList.summary: Kairi brings a new client to Yug, hoping that winning her case against her boyfriend will help clear Yug's image. But what will happen when Yug realises the case is against his own brother, Shaurya?

episodesList.title: Kairi Ka Plan
episodesList.summary: Kairi comes up with a plan to help Shaurya. Soon after, Yug finds out that Kairi had lied to him.

episodesList.title: Mr Majnu Calls Kairi
episodesList.summary: Yug calls Kairi as Mr Majnu and attempts to find out more about the case that he has undertaken. Later, Yug creates a situation to bring the cat out of the bag.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Speaks Up
episodesList.summary: Kairi encourages Shaurya to speak up before Yug. Yug's reaction to Shaurya's confession surprises his brothers.

episodesList.title: Bass Ho Gaya Bhaiya
episodesList.summary: Yug arrives at Anya's residence without Kairi and Shaurya. On returning home, Shaurya tells Yug that he wishes to separate from him.

episodesList.title: Kairi Ka Darr
episodesList.summary: Kairi finds Yug unconscious and after cleaning up Yug's wound, she stops Yug's brothers from leaving. The following day, Yug shocks Kairi's step siblings.

episodesList.title: Nakli Didi
episodesList.summary: Yug tells Kairi's siblings that she isn't their real sister. Shocked and hurt, they struggle to process the truth. Will they confront Kairi about it?

episodesList.title: Kairi Loses Her Family
episodesList.summary: Kundan realises that chaos would break out if Indrani saw him at her house. Soon after, Kairi challenges Yug that she'd find a way to win the custody case of her step siblings.

episodesList.title: Kairi Challenges Yug
episodesList.summary: When Kairi goes for her interview, she finds Yug there instead of the employer. Later, Biscuit asks Kairi to not interfere in the matters of his house and ends up hurting her deeply.

episodesList.title: Kairi Ki Majnu Se Mulakaat
episodesList.summary: Kairi receives Mr Majnu's call and finally meets him at the restaurant. While Yug overhears their conversation, the man pretending to be Mr Majnu asks Kairi to marry him.

episodesList.title: Maeri Prepares For The Wedding
episodesList.summary: Maeri overhears Yug and Kairi's conversation, misunderstands and makes preparations for their wedding. Meanwhile, Yug meets the man Kairi is going to get married to.

episodesList.title: Kairi Ki Haldi
episodesList.summary: Kairi meets her step-siblings and tells them that she will be getting married. Later, Maeri decorates the entire house for the upcoming wedding ceremonies.

episodesList.title: Yug Tries To Find A Connection
episodesList.summary: Yug finds out that the haldi sent by Jai Khanna was delivered by Vikram's driver. Meanwhile, Maeri and Kairi's siblings apply haldi and mehndi to Kairi. Will Yug uncover a link between Vikram and Jai Khanna?

episodesList.title: Maeri Emotionally Blackmails Yug
episodesList.summary: Maeri loses her calm on seeing Jai, after which, she makes Yug promise her that he'd get married to Kairi. Later, Gujiya tells Kairi about Jay not being the right person for her.

episodesList.title: Yug Stops Kairi's Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Yug arrives and stops Kairi and her loved ones from celebrating her wedding. Soon after, Kairi decides to seek revenge on Yug.

episodesList.title: Yug Refrains From Telling Kairi The Truth
episodesList.summary: Yug refrains from telling Kairi the truth about Jai. Meanwhile, Gujiya attempts to find a way to stop Kairi from getting married.

episodesList.title: Maeri Locks Kairi
episodesList.summary: Maeri manipulates Kairi and locks her in a room, refusing to let her get married to Jai. Meanwhile, Yug realises that he has misjudged Kairi and attempts to find out who Jai's boss is.

episodesList.title: Main Hoon Majnu
episodesList.summary: Yug arrives at the temple, interrupts Kairi's wedding, and claims that he is the real Mr Majnu. Soon after, the judge of the custody case runs into Kairi and the others at the temple.

episodesList.title: Yug And Kairi's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Yug shocks everyone by announcing he will marry Kairi and take custody of the siblings. But with him constantly interfering in her life, will Kairi agree to the marriage?

episodesList.title: Majburi Wali Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Gujiya drops clues from the van for Yug and Kairi to trace. Later, Yug dictates the terms of his marriage to Kairi before everybody.

episodesList.title: Kairi's Attempt To Stay Positive
episodesList.summary: Shaurya creates a scene at home and calls out Yug's double standards. Meanwhile, Kairi attempts to stay positive and listens to Mr Majnu's pre-recorded tapes.

episodesList.title: Kairi Ka Griha Pravesh
episodesList.summary: Kairi, Maeri and Tarazu come up with a plan to carry out the ceremony of Kairi's Griha Pravesh. How will Yug react when he finds out about the same?

episodesList.title: Biwi Banne Ka Haq
episodesList.summary: Yug confronts Kairi when she claims the wedding is a truth, not a lie. Later, he challenges her to clear the Bar Council exam in 12 days. How will Kairi respond?

episodesList.title: Yug Defends Kairi
episodesList.summary: Shaurya interrupts Anya's function. Later, Yug defends Kairi when she arrives at Anya's residence to sort the matter.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Ka Accident
episodesList.summary: Shaurya confronts Yug for not allowing him to marry Anya. But soon after, Shaurya meets with an accident. Will this change Yug's decision?

episodesList.title: Yug Makes A Choice
episodesList.summary: While the entire household celebrates that Shaurya is going to get married, Anya's mother puts forth a condition before Yug.

episodesList.title: Kairi Arranges The Janmashtami Pooja
episodesList.summary: Kairi attempts to convince Yug about finding a way to change Shalini's mind. Later, Kairi makes arrangements for the Janmashtami pooja.

episodesList.title: Saath Din Ki Saza
episodesList.summary: When Shalini sees through the facade that Yug and Kairi put on during the Janmashtami Pooja, Shaurya suggests Shalini move in with them for a week.

episodesList.title: Yug Accepts Kairi's Challenge
episodesList.summary: Yug is taken aback by the changes Kairi makes to his room and finds them ridiculous. Soon after, Yug accepts Kairi's challenge.

episodesList.title: Welcoming Shalini
episodesList.summary: Kairi makes all the necessary preparations and welcomes Shalini and Anya to their house. At the breakfast table, Kairi is compelled to think on her feet.

episodesList.title: Yug And Kairi Put Up An Act
episodesList.summary: Kairi and Yug put on a show of being in love to mislead Shalini. Meanwhile, Biscuit is accused of using the perfume Anya had sent for Shaurya. How will he stand up to her?

episodesList.title: Kairi Prepares For Her Exam
episodesList.summary: While Biscuit overhears the conversation between Shaurya and Shalini, Yug helps Kairi prepare for her exam.

episodesList.title: Kairi Confesses Her Feelings
episodesList.summary: Kairi tells Yug about having feelings for him. Later, Shalini wishes to get Shaurya and Anya married early.

episodesList.title: Kairi Forgets Her Hall Ticket
episodesList.summary: While Yug gives Kairi her hall ticket that she forgets at home, Maeri falls unconscious on the road.

episodesList.title: Mission KaYug
episodesList.summary: Anya commences mission KaYug and gives Kairi some instructions. Later, Anya and Shaurya get engaged.

episodesList.title: Maeri Slaps Yug
episodesList.summary: Shalini is shocked on finding out about Lata. Meanwhile, Meari regains her memory and slaps Yug amidst Shaurya and Anya's engagement celebrations.

episodesList.title: Maeri Is Taken To The Asylum
episodesList.summary: Maeri is taken to the mental asylum while Yug struggles with the guilt of killing Lata. Later, Maeri gets admitted to the hospital. Will Yug finally confront his guilt or is there another truth waiting to come out?

episodesList.title: Lata Saves Kairi's Life
episodesList.summary: Yug is bound to a chair by his brothers and Kairi. Later, Lata saves Kairi when she collapses in a room up in flames.

episodesList.title: Yug Surrenders Himself
episodesList.summary: While Kairi pleads with Lata and asks her to prove Yug's innocence, Yug surrenders himself to the police. What are Lata's intentions?

episodesList.title: Lata Arrives At Yug's Residence
episodesList.summary: Kairi tells Yug that Lata is alive. Meanwhile, Lata makes an appearance at Yug's residence before the police and the press.

episodesList.title: Yug Surprises Everybody
episodesList.summary: Yug surprises everybody by asking Kairi to always remain by his side. Later, Lata tells Kairi that she knows Yug better.

episodesList.title: Maeri's Changed Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Maeri returns on regaining her memory and is greeted by Lata. Later, Maeri dispenses Kairi and makes a shocking demand before Yug.

episodesList.title: Lata Ka Griha Pravesh
episodesList.summary: After her surgery, Maeri gathers the entire family to talk. Later, she asks Lata to do a Griha Pravesh with Yug. How will Kairi take this?

episodesList.title: Yug Decides To Leave
episodesList.summary: Lata performs the rituals of Graha Pravesh and enters Yug's house. Later, Yug tells Kairi that Lata is a master manipulator and decides to leave for a few days.

episodesList.title: Yug And Kairi's Facade
episodesList.summary: Yug and Kairi put up a show before the officials from the Child Welfare Association, that are actually hired actors arranged by Kairi. But was it Kairi's plan all along or Lata's manipulative move?

episodesList.title: Kairi And Biscuit Argue
episodesList.summary: Gujiya and Imarti decide to teach Lata a lesson. Later, Kairi and Biscuit get into a heated argument.

episodesList.title: Lata's Manipulative Schemes
episodesList.summary: Yug shows up and the outhouse and sleeps next to Kairi. The following day, Lata sows seeds of distrust amongst Kairi and Biscuit.

episodesList.title: Yug Comforts Kairi
episodesList.summary: Kairi is heartbroken when Maeri is rude to her. Yug comforts Kairi when he sees her in distress.

episodesList.title: Lata Ka Plan
episodesList.summary: While Lata wishes to bring home the Ganpati idol of her choice, she learns that Kairi has already booked it. Meanwhile, Maeri insists that Lata should bring the lawyer Ganpati idol instead of Kairi. How will this unfold?

episodesList.title: Lata Compels Yug
episodesList.summary: Lata compels Yug to perform the Ganpati aarti with her. Meanwhile, Kairi and the other family members perform the aarti for their Ganpati at the outhouse.

episodesList.title: Lata Ke Bina Family Photo
episodesList.summary: Maeri visits Kairi's Ganesh Idol to seek blessings. Later, the family takes a picture without Lata.

episodesList.title: Ekk Teer, Teen Nishan
episodesList.summary: Maeri gets frustrated with Kairi. Soon after, Yug yells at Kairi for being careless with the property papers.

episodesList.title: Maeri's Ask
episodesList.summary: Lata sides with Yug before his brothers, making Yug feel grateful for her statement. Soon after, Maeri asks Kairi to give Lata back her life by stepping out of the way.

episodesList.title: Yug Meets With An Accident
episodesList.summary: While Maeri attempts to take off Kairi's bangles, Tarazu informs them about Yug having met with an accident. Later, Lata accuses Kairi of being careless about the property papers.

episodesList.title: Kairi Ka Suhaag
episodesList.summary: Kairi feels insecure about her marriage because of Lata and decides to ask Shaurya where he got the papers from. How will she strike back at Lata?

episodesList.title: Kairi Confronts Lata
episodesList.summary: Kairi realises that Lata was the one who helped Shaurya find the property papers. Later, Kairi finds the brake wire hidden in a plant pot.

episodesList.title: Maeri Slaps Lata
episodesList.summary: While Lata accepts that she cut the brake wire of Yug's car, Biscuit has a change of heart towards Yug. Later, Maeri slaps Lata.

episodesList.title: The Results Of The Contest
episodesList.summary: Lata and Kairi unveil the results of their contest. Soon after, on receiving a call, Kairi rushes to Samay's school.

episodesList.title: Kairi's Source Of Hope
episodesList.summary: Lata accuses Kairi of not taking her responsibilities seriously. Later, Gujiya and Imarti encourage Kairi to take a stand against Lata.

episodesList.title: Lata's Traps
episodesList.summary: Lata sows seeds of doubt towards Kairi in Shaurya's head. Later, while Gujiya walks into Lata's trap, Kundan walks out of jail.

episodesList.title: Sankat Ka Sanket
episodesList.summary: Kundan thanks Lata for getting him out of jail, while she asks him to take Gujiya away. Meanwhile, Maeri observes that Kairi's plan is thriving while Lata's is not.

episodesList.title: Yug Fools Kundan
episodesList.summary: Yug lures Kundan with the help of a fake scheme to find out his location. Soon after, Samay and Shlok disguise themselves and arrive at Kundan's doorstep to rescue Gujiya.

episodesList.title: Gujiya's Trauma
episodesList.summary: Kundan informs Lata about Gujiya having been rescued by Samay and Shlok. On returning home, Kairi is informed about the trauma Gujiya is going through.

episodesList.title: A Shocking Revelation For Maeri
episodesList.summary: Maeri wishes to find out the truth about Yug's feelings. Later, Maeri finds out about her second daughter being alive.

episodesList.title: Gujiya Ki Awaz Aa Gayi
episodesList.summary: Yug and Kairi's fight makes Gujiya regain her lost voice. Later, Gujiya tells Kairi about Lata's intentions.

episodesList.title: Maeri Receives Shocking News
episodesList.summary: On Gujiya and Imarti's request, Maeri talks to Lata about leaving Yug's house on Dussehra. Later, Maeri has a breakdown after receiving a call.

episodesList.title: Kairi Ki Kidnapping
episodesList.summary: Lata instructs Kundan to kidnap Kairi, but just as he begins to act, Yug arrives unexpectedly. Will Kundan be able to carry out the plan, or will Yug's presence change everything?

plotHtml:
Yug Sinha, a sharp yet emotionally distant lawyer, has lost faith in love following a painful betrayal. His life takes a dramatic turn when he crosses paths with Kairi Sharma, a spirited young woman juggling multiple jobs while raising her three younger siblings — Biscuit, Imarti, and Gujiya.
Yug and Kairi immediately clash because of their opposing worldviews — he is practical and guarded, while she is hopeful and guided by her heart. Their constant run-ins, both at home and in the courtroom, lead to a series of emotional confrontations and comic misunderstandings.
Despite their differences, a deeper bond gradually develops as both are forced to confront their pasts and support their families through personal and legal struggles. Their relationship becomes even more complicated with the return of Lata, Yug's mysterious ex-wife, who brings unresolved emotions and hidden motives.

title: Uppu Puli Kaaram
summary:
Uppu Puli Kaaram (transl. Salt Sour Spicy) is a 2024 Indian Tamil-language television series, which is an official remake of the South Korean series My Father Is Strange. Directed by M. Ramesh Baarathi and Chidambaram Manivannan for Disney+ Hotstar. The show revolves around modern love, with stories on relationships in the modern generation.
The principal characters of the series include Ponvannan, Vanitha Krishnachandran, Naveen Muralidhar, Ayesha Zeenath, Ashwini Aanandita, Deepika Venkatachalam, Krishna Raghunandhan, Farina Azad, Raj Ayyappa and Pranav Mohan. It is scheduled to premiere on Disney+ Hotstar on 30 May 2024 and ended with 128 episodes on 2 January 2025. It also airs on Star Vijay from 26 October 2025 on every Sunday at 5:00 PM. A spiritual successor of the web series titled Brothers and Sisters was released on 27 May 2025.

episodesList.title: Meet the UPK Family
episodesList.summary: Meet the lovely family of Subramani and Subbu. As they try to convince Chinmayi to wed, her siblings eavesdrop on them. Shiva is surprised to run into his past love, Chinmayi.

episodesList.title: Matchmaking
episodesList.summary: Shiva is elated that Chinmayi is unmarried, but she is irked when he questions her. As her parents struggle to stall a matchmaking, the groom is shocked by Chinmayi's confession.

episodesList.title: Hurdles and Hope
episodesList.summary: Thippu is angry as he becomes a meme material for his acting performance. Subramani gets a notice to vacate the hotel premises. Shiva is excited to learn about the college reunion.

episodesList.title: Showdown
episodesList.summary: Subbu argues with Sharmila only to realise that she is the new owner. Shiva is irked as Chinmayi evades him. All hell breaks loose as the siblings turn the house into a war ground.

episodesList.title: Conundrum
episodesList.summary: Yashika finally clears an interview but lands in a fix as she meets Sushi, her college senior. Thippu is elated to get a chance to star in a web series but it is a father-son story.

episodesList.title: Resolutions
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi convinces Yashika to take up the job. Thippu feels humiliated as the director rejects him for his soulless acting. He decides to find out about his father.

episodesList.title: Celebration and Chaos
episodesList.summary: As the family celebrates Yashika's new job, Thippu learns his father's name. The mornings become more chaotic as the three sisters struggle to get ready on time.

episodesList.title: New Beginnings
episodesList.summary: Things get personal as Chinmayi and Shiva take centre stage in a debate show. While Yashika is excited on her first day of work, she gets into an embarrassing situation with Thippu.

episodesList.title: Frustrated Souls
episodesList.summary: While Shiva gets warned by his boss, Chinmayi becomes drunk after losing a case for the first time in her career. Things take an unexpected turn when the frustrated duo meet again.

episodesList.title: Restless Curiosity
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi gets disturbed after learning about what transpired the previous night. As Subramani and Subbu visit their friend, Keerthy gets curious about Uday's antics.

episodesList.title: Unveiling Secrets
episodesList.summary: Keerthy decides to catch Uday red-handed, while Yashika learns that Thippu is a celebrity. Shiva and Chinmayi get excited about participating in a game show.

episodesList.title: Unexpected Encounters
episodesList.summary: While Uday secretly visits the house in disguise, Shiva tricks Chinmayi into going out on a dinner date with him. Things go out of control when Subbu and Sharmila come face to face.

episodesList.title: Emotional Transformations
episodesList.summary: Impressed with Udhay's cooking, Sushi desires to marry him. Chinmayi gets rebuked by Subbu, while Thippu recreates a scene with enthusiasm after learning about his father.

episodesList.title: Ambitions Revealed
episodesList.summary: Keerthi doubts Udhay and checks his wallet to find a shopping bill. Chinmay is happy for Yashika. Udhay tells Chinmayi about his wish to open a restaurant instead of studying.

episodesList.title: Family Dynamics
episodesList.summary: Keerthi doubts Udhay and checks his wallet to find a shopping bill. Chinmay is happy for Yashika. Udhay tells Chinmayi about his wish to quit studying and open a multi-cuisine eatery.

episodesList.title: Critical Acts
episodesList.summary: Sharmila rescues Sharmila in time as the name board of her new coffee shop collapses. While the sisters bully Udhay, Shiva threatens to wed someone else if Chinmayi rejects him.

episodesList.title: Parental Longing
episodesList.summary: Sharmila expresses her feelings to her son, Shiva and tells him how much she misses him. One of Chinmayi's seniors asks her to meet his friend's son.

episodesList.title: Guidance and Care
episodesList.summary: Thippu teaches dialogue delivery to an unwilling Yashika. Chinmayi feels anxious as Shiva has neither called nor responded to her text messages.

episodesList.title: Crucial Messages
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi tells Anirudh to inform Shiva that she is going to meet a prospective groom. Subbu and her mother explore commercial properties for a shop.

episodesList.title: Curious Provocations
episodesList.summary: Keerthi takes a picture of Mahi to analyse why girls are drooling over him. Chinmayi meets her prospective groom and sends a selfie with him to Shiva.

episodesList.title: Unvoiced Desires
episodesList.summary: Thippu visits Subramani's hotel and yearns to call him father. A jealous Chinmayi rushes to Shiva's house at night to check on him.

episodesList.title: Shaming Revelations
episodesList.summary: Sushi ridicules Yashika and informs her colleagues about her being overweight in college. Keerthi is astonished to receive an invite to her ex-boyfriend's wedding.

episodesList.title: Meeting Mayhem
episodesList.summary: Chinmay bashes the matchmaker for bringing proposals for her. Yashika loses her calm and unleashes her karate skills when Sushi tries to oust her from the office meeting.

episodesList.title: Shocking Disclosure
episodesList.summary: Thippu feels terrible when he is replaced in a project based on a father-son relationship. Subramani's past comes back to haunt him when he meets a drunk Thippu.

episodesList.title: Mysterious Aroma
episodesList.summary: Gowtham helps Chinmayi defuse the attempts of the marriage broker. While Sharmila smells a lady's perfume on Shiva, Subbu tries to get Thippu's details.

episodesList.title: Unseen Omen
episodesList.summary: Sushi calls Udhay to meet for dinner, but he refuses. Sharmila's order shocks Subbu while Sheela questions Shiva about Chinmay. A dizzy spell leads to a startling revelation for Sushi.

episodesList.title: The Tangled Consequence
episodesList.summary: Thippu insists on firing Yashika from the job when he falls and gets hurt as she accidentally pulls a wire entangled in his chair. Keerthi encounters the unexpected at the gym.

episodesList.title: Heartfelt Commitment
episodesList.summary: Sharmila feels touched after reading Chandrashekar's poem. While Yashika tries to apologise to Thippu, Subramani vows to take care of him as his son. The doctor confirms Sushi's doubt.

episodesList.title: Hidden Pursuits
episodesList.summary: Subramani's search for Thippu's number leads him to Yashika's office, and he hides to avoid being noticed. Sharmila turns suspicious after finding a hairband in Shiva's room.

episodesList.title: Ultimatum and Disclosure
episodesList.summary: Keerthi demands Mahi's presence at a wedding, or she warns about divulging his secret. Sushi's revelation turns Udhay's life into a nightmare.

episodesList.title: Deceptive Disarray
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi delights everyone with breakfast and announces her plans to relocate closer to work for convenience. Udhay's lies regarding riches and the restaurant come to the fore.

episodesList.title: Intriguing Mysteries
episodesList.summary: Keerthi is intrigued by Mahi's rich appearance in a photo and doubts his true identity. The chaos intensifies when Sushi discovers Udhay's lies.

episodesList.title: Verdicts and Visions
episodesList.summary: As the family debates Chinmayi moving out, Subramani's decision disappoints her. Mahi's contrived closeness makes Keerthi wish their act is real.

episodesList.title: Verbal Duel
episodesList.summary: Sushi visits Annam Mess and learns of Udhay's lies. Much against his wish, Shiva is forced to collaborate with Thippu on a fictional show. An anxious Subramani visits Thippu.

episodesList.title: Tense Transition
episodesList.summary: Ramya is shocked to learn about Udhay's pregnant girlfriend from Kalyan. Chinmayi panics when her parents decide to accompany her to her new house. Sushi feels unwell in the office.

episodesList.title: Authentic Assurance
episodesList.summary: Thippu gets angry when Yashika asks him about his father. Elated, Keerthi questions Mahi about his feelings. A worried Subramani takes food for Thippu. Sushi faints on the road.

episodesList.title: Boundaries and Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi sets ground rules for living with Shiva. Udhay returns home after his exam to a delightful surprise from his loving family.

episodesList.title: Dawn Discord
episodesList.summary: Chaos ensues when Sushi walks into Annam Mess and introduces herself to Subramani. Chinmay, Keerthi and Yashika resolve not to let Sushi trouble the family.

episodesList.title: Tactical Insight
episodesList.summary: Yashika advises Thippu, using a sports analogy, leading him to make a significant decision. Keerthi changes her voice to feign illness and skip work.

episodesList.title: Ring Ruckus
episodesList.summary: Sharmila appoints Subbu to help with her new coffee shop. Trouble ensues when Sharmila loses her diamond ring.

episodesList.title: Prejudice and Fixation
episodesList.summary: Sharmila accuses Subbu when her ring gets lost. The sisters are eager to know about Udhay's girlfriend, while Thippu feels anxious over a phone call.

episodesList.title: Memories and Murmurs
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi tries to deal with her bittersweet memories. Meanwhile, is Thippu head over heels in love?

episodesList.title: Mixed Emotions
episodesList.summary: Yashika is happy yet confused over Thippu's situation. Shiva's impatience boggles his decisions. The tables turn for Sushi, leaving her in shock.

episodesList.title: Confrontations Over Dinner
episodesList.summary: Yashika and Sushi feel awkward at the dinner table. Thippu's bond with Subramani moulds his acting. Sushi's efforts towards atonement fail to mend her deeds.

episodesList.title: Remedies and Regret
episodesList.summary: Shiva visits his mom with a request. Thippu's acting skills are put to the test for his new show. How will he perform?

episodesList.title: Longing of Unloved Souls
episodesList.summary: Thippu asks Subramani an important question and waits anxiously for his reply. Keerthi's boss suspects someone is squatting in the gym and decides to investigate, alarming her.

episodesList.title: Uneasy Love
episodesList.summary: A discussion at breakfast with Chinmayi gives Shiva a new perspective on this career. Ramya gets suspicious about Subramani's whereabouts and tells Subbu.

episodesList.title: Ruined Dreams
episodesList.summary: Subramani's visit to Thippu's house creates tension, leading to a confrontation with Subbu. Keerthi's dreams get shattered when Mahi receives a ring.

episodesList.title: Reconciliations
episodesList.summary: Mani tries to convince Subbu to allow him his fatherly duties. Thippu's oversharing makes him feel awkward around Yashika. Sushi worries about her secrets being exposed.

episodesList.title: Conditional/Unconditional
episodesList.summary: Mahi thanks his brother for the timely help. While Shiva and Chinmayi get ready to make dinner, Sharmila suddenly visits her son's house to give him an ultimatum.

episodesList.title: Tangled Conflicts
episodesList.summary: The family worries about Mani's ulcer. Shiva's mornings are not the same with Chinmayi around. Thippu gets provoked during a photoshoot.

episodesList.title: Dazed and Confused
episodesList.summary: Kalyan's advice dampens Udhay's excitement over the wedding. The kids become confused by Subbu's unusual message.

episodesList.title: House-quake
episodesList.summary: Thippu's moving in takes everyone off guard. Frustrated, the four siblings express their objections to the decision.

episodesList.title: Lost in Rumination
episodesList.summary: Subbu conveys Thippu's existence to her mother, Kalyan and Ramya. The siblings worry about living with their half-brother.

episodesList.title: Arrivals in Waiting
episodesList.summary: Udhay fusses over Sushi after visiting the doctor. Sharmila surprises Shiva with a blind date. Disappointed with her dad, Keerthi drowns her sorrows in alcohol at the gym.

episodesList.title: Rising Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Thippu breaks the news of his new living situation to Yashika. Armed with his lucky charm, he gets ready to move houses.

episodesList.title: Trying to Fit In
episodesList.summary: Despite Subramani's assurances, Thippu gets a lukewarm welcome. Yashika grows increasingly anxious when she is faced with the new reality.

episodesList.title: Cloud Burst
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi reveals the Thippu situation to Shiva, who finally connects the dots. Yashika calls out Sushi in front of Udhay, angering the former bully.

episodesList.title: Flat-Footed
episodesList.summary: Sushi and Udhay go house hunting but become disappointed, till Udhay offers a solution. Shiva calls out Sheela's name in his sleep, angering Chinmayi. A shock awaits Subbu at home.

episodesList.title: Running in Circles
episodesList.summary: Mahi sees a new side to Keerthi. Chinmayi comes across an unpleasant voice recording. Yashika strongly opposes Udhay's solution to his house problem and gets Thippu's support.

episodesList.title: Unspoken Strains
episodesList.summary: Udhay prepares breakfast and eagerly awaits Thippu's praise for his food. Chinmayi meets Yashika and subtly probes what's troubling her about Sushi.

episodesList.title: Fractured Bonds
episodesList.summary: Sushi reveals the reason behind her bullying of Yashika. Shiva asks Chinmayi's opinion on marriage, but she hopes he'll directly propose instead.

episodesList.title: Annoyed Reaction
episodesList.summary: Kalyan spills paint at work and gets harshly scolded by his boss, which Ramya sees. Mahi gets irritated by Keerthi's touch and sternly warns her to keep her distance.

episodesList.title: Heightened Tensions
episodesList.summary: Sushi's emotional outburst stirs Yashika. Keerthi spots Chinmayi and Shiva together at a convenience store. What follows next sends Chinmayi into a tizzy.

episodesList.title: Tote for Truths
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi resolves the issue with Keerthi by buying her a branded bag. Shiva feels elated to learn that Chinmayi is interested in marrying him.

episodesList.title: Shadows of the Past
episodesList.summary: Thippu requests George to take Yashika off her role as his manager. Subramani delves into his past and uncovers a devastating tragedy from his childhood.

episodesList.title: Solitary Whispers
episodesList.summary: Subramani gives Udhay money for a wedding dress and advises him to be responsible. Subbu takes the girls shopping. Udhay's words make Thippu feel isolated within the family.

episodesList.title: Forbidden Entanglements
episodesList.summary: Keerthi reveals about Chinmayi to Yashika and Udhay. What happens when Subbu learns about Chinmayi's live-in relationship?

episodesList.title: Shattered Loyalties
episodesList.summary: Subbu is dumbfounded when she spots Chinmayi with Shiva. Sharmila cannot believe her ears when she learns that her son is in love with Chinmayi. What will the lovers do?

episodesList.title: Fatherly Sentiments
episodesList.summary: During an interview, Thippu becomes emotional when asked about his bond with his father. Keerthi learns the truth about Mahi and Raj.

episodesList.title: Healing Distance
episodesList.summary: Shiva's dad advises and asks him to seek Sharmila's forgiveness, but she sets conditions. Chinmayi and Shiva decide to stay away till the problem is resolved.

episodesList.title: Fury Unleashed
episodesList.summary: A furious Sharmila lashes out at Subramani and decides to sell the entire property. Yashika is impressed with Thippu's progress. Shiva arrives at Chinmayi's home to meet her family.

episodesList.title: Heartfelt Crossroads
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi feels torn between her furious parents and Shiva's request to wed. Thippu pacifies an irate Subbu by bringing her favourite Burmese food with Yashika. Why is Udhay angry?

episodesList.title: Guilt Trip
episodesList.summary: Sharmila's condition leaves Shiva feeling frustrated. Sushi's shocking revelation about her parents astounds Udhay. Besieged by guilt, Keerthi prepares to encounter Mahi at the gym.

episodesList.title: Performance Plummet
episodesList.summary: Subbu asks Thippu to shift to Udhay's 'cramped' room. Thippu's web series gets launched. However, the director is not pleased with his lacklustre performance.

episodesList.title: Mentorship and Awakening
episodesList.summary: Subramani advises Thippu on how to hone his acting abilities. Chinmayi and Sharmila have a heated argument. Shiva discovers a startling revelation about Chinmayi and his mother.

episodesList.title: Sorrowful Solace
episodesList.summary: Subramani overhears as Chinmayi shares her sorrow with Yashika and Keerthi. Angry with his mother, Shiva leaves his house. Yashika and Udhay help Thippu move into a new room.

episodesList.title: Heartfelt Confrontation
episodesList.summary: Udhay confides about his fear to his father. Shiva admonishes Sheela for talking ill about Chinmayi. Will Mahi confess his love to Keerthi?

episodesList.title: Candid Exchanges
episodesList.summary: A dejected Shiva informs his father of his resolution to end his relationship with Chinmayi. Sharmila is adamant about her decision. Thippu expresses his feelings to Subramani.

episodesList.title: Essential Modifications
episodesList.summary: Subramani requests Udhay to revise the catering plan in light of the budget constraints. Depressed, Shiva packs his things to move abroad.

episodesList.title: Sorrowful Hearts
episodesList.summary: Subbu reflects on the sorrowful past of Kasinathan and his mother, pondering how they endured such hardships and how the hospital nurse helped them. How was the kind nurse?

episodesList.title: Troubled Turns
episodesList.summary: Thippu accidentally loses Keerthi's handbag. Kalyan worries about his job. For his action practice scenes, Thippu gets stunt masters. But what happens to put him in a tough spot?

episodesList.title: Support and Departure
episodesList.summary: Keerthi helps Thippu to relieve his body pain. Kalyan puts Subbu in a tough spot. While Shiva returns Chinmayi’s belongings, she learns that he has vacated the house.

episodesList.title: Gifted Frustrations
episodesList.summary: Keerthi gets furious as Udhay gives her handbag to Suchi. Thippu treats a depressed Chinmay to dinner. Later, Chinmay is shocked to see Sharmila at her doorstep. What is her motive?

episodesList.title: Radiant Makeover
episodesList.summary: Sharmila pleads with Chinmayi to help her search for her son, Shiva. A fabulous makeover of Keerthi, Chinmayi and Yashika for Udhay and Sushi's marriage leaves everyone in awe.

episodesList.title: Embracing Truths
episodesList.summary: At Udhay and Sushi's wedding reception, Grandma's disclosure leaves the family shocked. Chinmayi heads to her friend's house, looking for a clue to locate Shiva. Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Jealousy Unveiled
episodesList.summary: Seeing Yashika with Sunil, a jealous Thippu berates her. A reluctant Mahi admits his feelings to Keerthi. Sushi gets irked as she is removed from a vital project due to her pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Condition and Preparations
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi imposes conditions on Shiva for their marriage. Subramani prepares food and sends Udhay to deliver it to Thippu's shooting location. How will Sushi react?

episodesList.title: Balanced Discretion
episodesList.summary: Subbu tells Subramani to treat Thippu and Udhay equally. Keerthi wants Mahi to keep their relationship a secret. Sushi fusses over food.

episodesList.title: Fear and Future
episodesList.summary: After watching the scary movie, Thippu freaks out. Chinmayi and Shiva inform their respective parents about their final decision. Will their families agree to their alliance?

episodesList.title: Dissonant Voices
episodesList.summary: Subbu's mother watches Thippu making trip plans with Subramani and assigns him some work. Sushi gets angry with Udhay's grandmother's interference and berates him for being jobless.

episodesList.title: Serious Commitment
episodesList.summary: Serious about marriage, Chinmayi and Shiva try to convince their respective parents of the alliance. Thippu gets enraged as Yashika gets an acting opportunity alongside Sunil.

episodesList.title: Emotional Gambit
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi meets Shiva's parents while the latter visits her family to persuade them of their marriage. Thippu decides to test Shiva's love for Chinmayi. Will he succeed?

episodesList.title: Exposed Frames
episodesList.summary: Shiva and Chinmayi get Subbu and Subramani's consent. Keerthi is surprised as Mahi does not have his photo on his phone. Thippu flares up when Yashika and Sunil's selfie goes viral.

episodesList.title: Love's Test
episodesList.summary: Mahi's father visits the gym to see him and runs into Keerthi. Sharmila consents to Shiva and Chinmayi's marriage but on one condition.

episodesList.title: Moments of Destiny
episodesList.summary: Thanks to their parents, Chinmayi and Shiva decide what's best for their relationship. Thippu enjoys a joyful birthday until he has a fateful encounter at his shoot location.

episodesList.title: Clarifications and Confessions
episodesList.summary: Mahi promises to be an ideal partner to a tense Keerthi. Sharmila tries to blackmail Shiva emotionally. Thippu informs George that Yashika is family. Udhay's exam results are out.

episodesList.title: Endorsement
episodesList.summary: Sharmila invites Subbu for coffee and agrees to Shiva and Chinmayi's wedding without any condition. Yashika helps a pregnant Sushi at work. However, what is Sushi hiding from Udhay?

episodesList.title: Wedding Prelude
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi conveys her joy to Shiva, but Sheela tries to dissuade him from marrying her. Yashika warns Sushi against going on an outdoor shoot. The excited girls shop for the wedding.

episodesList.title: Celebration of Love
episodesList.summary: Everyone is happy at Shiva and Chinmayi's wedding. Subbu and Sharmila give emotional speeches. This time, Thippu joins in for a family photo.

episodesList.title: Pivotal Moments
episodesList.summary: The family misses Chinmayi. Sharmila tries to ruin Shiva and Chinmayi's wedding night. Raj seeks Keerthi's aid to convince Mahi to join the family business.

episodesList.title: Buzzing Headlines
episodesList.summary: Sushi is urged to rest and to refrain from going to work during her pregnancy. Thippu feels uneasy doing romantic scenes in front of Yashika. Thippu and Subramani’s news goes viral.

episodesList.title: Silent Confrontations
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi advises Subramani and Subbu to stay silent and not to respond to anyone. Thippu’s mother unexpectedly turns up and pressurises him to set up a meeting with Subramani.

episodesList.title: Fateful Encounters
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi informs Shiva that his mother's arm is not fractured. Yashoda visits the mess to meet Subramani and leaves her address. Subramani decides to tell Thippu the truth.

episodesList.title: Unexpected Arrival
episodesList.summary: Mahi's father, C. Mohan, agrees to help him start a sports academy. Chinmayi and Shiva pay her family a surprise visit. Is Subramani's truth in jeopardy with Yashoda's arrival?

episodesList.title: Solemn Confessions
episodesList.summary: Thippu informs Yashoda of the joyous days he shared with his father and the family. Keerthi gets a prominent post in Mahi's company. Thippu learns about his father's car driving skills.

episodesList.title: The Blooming Doubts
episodesList.summary: Subbu cautions Subramani to stay composed. Sharmila experiences an unexpected pain in her chest. Thippu begins to wonder if Subramani is indeed his father.

episodesList.title: Web of Confusion
episodesList.summary: Sharmila is rushed to the hospital after Shiva and Chinmayi ignore her calls. Keerthi informs Subbu that she loves Mahi. Thippu initiates an investigation to find who Subramani truly is.

episodesList.title: Masked Agendas
episodesList.summary: Subbu and Subramani go to the hospital to meet Sharmila. Mahi's father makes a cunning move in the guise of a gift for Keerthi. Yashoda denies knowing the person in the photo.

episodesList.title: Heartbreaking Losses
episodesList.summary: Sushi suddenly loses her balance and faints at work, leading to complications. After causing a drunken scene in front of Annam Mess, Thippu finally receives the DNA test result.

episodesList.title: Reckonings of Truth
episodesList.summary: A misunderstanding causes Udhay to hit Mahi. Subramani visits the old-age home and learns of Thippu's visit on his birthday. Subbu receives the DNA report and tries calling Thippu.

episodesList.title: Thippu's Fury
episodesList.summary: Hurt and angry, Thippu speaks harshly to reporters during a press meet. Subbu tells Thippu the whole truth, which drives Thippu over the edge.

episodesList.title: Celebrating Milestones
episodesList.summary: Keerthi makes arrangements for Subramani’s 60th birthday. Yashika stands firm when Sunil asks George to appoint her as his manager. Thippu is invited to Subramani’s birthday.

episodesList.title: Bewildered Hearts
episodesList.summary: Everyone enjoys Subramani's birthday party. But, Thippu's words hurt Subramani and Subbu. Unaware of the situation, the rest of the family gets perplexed by Thippu's unusual behaviour.

episodesList.title: Secrets Unravelled
episodesList.summary: Keerthi receives her first incentive for successfully achieving the sales target. Yashika tries to avoid Thippu. Meanwhile, Chinmayi finds the DNA report.

episodesList.title: The Investigation Unfolds
episodesList.summary: Yashika seeks Chinmayi's help to find a house to rent. While Chinmayi begins to investigate the truth of the DNA report, Yashoda decides to take legal action against Subramani.

episodesList.title: Web of Deceit
episodesList.summary: Yashika is shocked to learn from Thippu about their fathers. Chinmayi seeks a friend's help to gather information about Subramani. Thippu forgives Subramani and leaves the house.

episodesList.title: Path to Redemption
episodesList.summary: Thippu admits his feelings to Yashika. Mahi meets Keerthi's family to seek consent for marriage. Subbu opens up to her children as Chinmayi confronts her parents about Subramani's lies.

episodesList.title: Quest for Justice
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi decides to revive Kasinadhan's case. Mahi's father taunts Keerthi for falling for his son. Chinmayi tells Shiva the truth and resolves to stay with her father for a few days.

episodesList.title: Clues Uncovered
episodesList.summary: Yashika decides to resign from her job to distance herself from Thippu. Chinmayi begins to gather proof for the case in Kerala. Meanwhile, Yashoda lodges a complaint against Kasinadhan.

episodesList.title: Release Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi orchestrates a way to evade her father's arrest. The news spreads, creating a sensation. Thippu tries to convince his mother to withdraw the case, but she has other plans.

episodesList.title: Words Unleashed
episodesList.summary: Mahi decides to reconcile with Keerthi once again. Chinmayi reveals her father's truth to her in-laws. Thippu apologises to Kasinathan.

episodesList.title: Threads Intertwined
episodesList.summary: Yashodha's lawyer attempts to gather information from Thippu. Chinmayi finds Rangan and tries to talk to him. Sushi prepares a gift for Udhay for his interview.

episodesList.title: The Last Supper?
episodesList.summary: Kasinathan gathers the whole family for a meal, believing it might be his last with them. The court hearing begins. Will Kasinathan be able to prove his innocence?

episodesList.title: Legal Battle
episodesList.summary: In the court, Rangan appears as an eyewitness. Udhay impresses the IAS panel with his confidence and insight. Mahi's father apologises to Keerthi for his past misconduct.

episodesList.title: Innocence Proven
episodesList.summary: Chinmayi presents irrefutable evidence, proving that Kasinathan is not a criminal but a man wrongly accused of murder. She questions Thippu and Yashodha and amazes all with her arguments.

episodesList.title: Heart’s Desire
episodesList.summary: Keerthi delights everyone with her anchoring skills. Yashika unveils her web series titled 'Uppu Puli Kaaram'. Thippu informs Kasinathan and Subbu about his intention to wed Yashika.

episodesList.title: Happy Ever After
episodesList.summary: The court issues a favourable verdict for Kasinathan. The wedding bells chime for Yashika and Thippu. There is happiness and laughter as everyone enjoys the special occasion together.

title: Udne Ki Aasha
summary: Udne Ki Aasha (transl. Hope to Fly) is an Indian Hindi-language television family drama series that premiered on 12 March 2024 on Star Plus and streams digitally on Disney+ Hotstar. It is produced by Rolling Tales Productions, and stars Neha Harsora and Kanwar Dhillon in lead roles. It is the Hindi adaptation of Star Vijay's Tamil series Siragadikka Aasai.
plot: Set against a Marathi backdrop, Udne Ki Aasha revolves around the middle-class lives of Sachin and Sailee as they navigate the complexities of their relationship. It centers on Sailee's struggles as she encounters a roadblock in the form of a resistant husband and her efforts to inspire change, not just for their own growth, but for the betterment of their entire family.

articleSections.text: The concept was developed in December 2023, and the first promo was released in February 2024.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: In January 2024, Neha Harsora was cast to play the female lead, while Kanwar Dhillon was cast as the male lead. In July 2026, The show took a 7 years leap, Radhika Vidyasagar portraying the role of Renuka quit the series, and was replaced by Sonali Naik. Abaan Khan was cast as Lakshya, Sachin and Sailee's son.

title: United Kacche
summary:
United Kacche is Hindi-language Slice of life comedy series starring Sunil Grover, Manu Rishi, Sapna Pabbi, Satish Shah, Nayani Dixitt, Neelu Kohli and Diksha Juneja. It is produced by Yoodlee Films and directed by Manav Shah and Dharampal Thakur. The show premiered on ZEE5 on 31 March 2023. It revolves around the lives of Indians, Pakistanis and Bangladeshis who are living in England as illegal immigrants and are thus known as Kachche.
The first news reports on the show appeared in December 2022, when it was reported as Sunil Grover and Sapna Pabbi have been signed by ZEE5.
plot: Tejnder Gill aka Tango manages to complete his father's lifelong wish to migrate to Europe, albeit illegally. The show follows Tejinder life in the UK as a "Kaccha", his relationship with his roommates, his family, his love life and his struggles finding a job while trying to avoid authorities.

title: Uppena
summary: Uppena is an Indian Telugu language soap opera premiered on 4 April 2022 airing on Gemini TV every Monday to Saturday and ended on 22 June 2024. It is available for worldwide streaming on Sun NXT. The show stars Soniya Suresh, Sheela Singh, Swetha and Vijaya Kotla in leading roles. The serial is the official remake of Tamil critically acclaimed television series Ethirneechal which was aired on Sun TV.
plot:
Chakravarthy and Parvati left their family as they married against their parents wishes. They were supported by Parvathi's brother. Janani was born and always lived under her father Chakravarthy's shadow. Janani met her best friend Gowtham in the college though her father didn’t like. Due to events, Gowtham left college makes Janani to feel depressed. She overcomes everything and became a topper. She lives with a sister Anjana and her cousins.
Gogineni Sivaram who is a business tycoon from Vijayawada came for a wedding proposal to Janani for his brother Abhiram. Initially Janani is not willing to marry, but later accepted after knowing Abhi’s innocence. All the in-laws of Gogineni's family are well educated but treated as housewives in the house. Janani doesn’t know the truth of the Gogineni brothers and Janani thinks Saraswathi, Gayathri and Vidya work in offices.
All brothers except Abhiram are misogynistic and abusive their wives. Their children and their sister Roopa also disrespected them. Despite warnings from Vasu and respective in-laws' parents, Janani married Abhiram. Sivaram assured a MD post for Janani for the new company. Finally Janani realises the true reality and Abhiram comforts her.

title: Unstoppable
summary: Unstoppable (marketed as Unstoppable with NBK) is an Indian Telugu-language streaming television talk show hosted by actor Nandamuri Balakrishna. The show premiered on 4 November 2021 on Aha. The first season became the most-watched show on Aha, amassing over 40 crore (400 million) streaming minutes. It also became the top-rated talk show in India on IMDb. The second season premiered on 14 October 2022, followed by a limited third season, which aired on 17 October 2023. The fourth season of Unstoppable premiered on 25 October 2024.
reception: Reviewing the first episode of second season, 123Telugu stated that "first episode of Unstoppable 2 is more serious than fun".

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
In early October 2021, Nandamuri Balakrishna was approached by Aha to host a talk show, with Krish Jagarlamudi serving as the director. Filming began at Annapurna Studios, though Balakrishna was injured during the shoot. The show was formally announced in late October, with its premiere scheduled for 4 November 2021.
For the second season, Prasanth Varma was hired to shoot the promotional teasers. The season's anthem song was sung by Roll Rida and composed by Mahati Swara Sagar. The first episode of the second season, featuring N. Chandrababu Naidu was filmed on 4 October 2022. An episode featuring Pawan Kalyan was shot on 27 December 2022.
The third season's first episode was filmed in early October 2023 and premiered on 17 October 2023, while the second episode was filmed in mid-November 2023.
In early October 2024, the fourth season was announced, with an animated trailer revealing the launch date of 25 October 2024. The first episode of the fourth season, featuring N. Chandrababu Naidu, was filmed on 20 October 2024 at Annapurna Studios. Initially, the second episode was scheduled to feature the cast of Kanguva, filmed on 24 October 2024. However, it was replaced by an episode featuring the cast and crew of Lucky Baskhar, which was shot on 28 October 2024. The Kanguva episode was later aired as the third episode on 8 November 2024. The episode featuring Ram Charan and Sharwanand was shot on 31 December 2024.

title: Unheard
summary: Unheard is an Indian Telugu-language historical drama television series created and directed by Aditya K. V. for Disney+ Hotstar. The series has an ensemble cast of Srinivas Avasarala, Priyadarshi Pulikonda, Ajay, Baladitya, Chandini Chowdary, and Ananda Chakrapani. The series premiered on 17 September 2021.
plot: Set in the period of 1905–1950, the series is based on the Indian independence movement in the Hyderabad State in common people's point of view on various major events during the said period.
reception: Sangeetha Devi Dundoo writing for The Hindu said, "If you can look past the staged theatre-like presentation, ‘Unheard’ can whet the appetite to know more about India's freedom struggle, through conflicting ideologies." Praising the performances, The Times of India critic Thadagadh Pathi wrote, "Actors like Ajay, Priyadarshi, Srinivas Avasarala, Chandini Chowdary and Baladitya deliver mature performances, which works well for the series. It is not an easy feat to perform such dialogue-driven characters and stories."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: Filming of the series was done between September and November 2020 following the COVID-19 protocols in and around Hyderabad. Cast and Crew were connected virtually for workshops on their individual roles. As the show pans decades, a lot of prosthetic work was involved on the cast to look appropriate for the year the sequences take place.

articleSections.title: Themes
articleSections.text: Aditya is an author who wrote the book Daitya Dairies. After making 13 years of research on the events, he has written the story and making debut as the filmmaker. Deccan Chronicle reported that "The 1918 influenza pandemic, the Spanish flu, which killed around 25 million, is one of the important episodes. Mahatma Gandhi also suffered from the Spanish Flu and was in isolation. The series chronicles how these deaths fuelled the freedom moment. It was during this time the movement gained momentum and began to spread." The series also showcases the lives of the people of the period and the battle they had fought against British and the Nizam of Hyderabad. Some of the major events that are shown are non-cooperation movement, chauri chaura incident and others.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Billed as the first Telugu Hotstar Specials show, all the episodes of the series were premiere on Disney+ Hotstar on 17 September 2021, The series was initially screened privately for the Vice President of India, Venkaiah Naidu. The show was also selected for screening at the 11th Dada Saheb Phalke Film Festival. In the United States, the show was streamed exclusively on Hulu.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Sangeetha Devi Dundoo writing for The Hindu said, "If you can look past the staged theatre-like presentation, ‘Unheard’ can whet the appetite to know more about India's freedom struggle, through conflicting ideologies." Praising the performances, The Times of India critic Thadagadh Pathi wrote, "Actors like Ajay, Priyadarshi, Srinivas Avasarala, Chandini Chowdary and Baladitya deliver mature performances, which works well for the series. It is not an easy feat to perform such dialogue-driven characters and stories."

title: Uma
summary: Uma is a 2021 Indian Bengali language sport drama television series broadcast on the Bengali general entertainment channel Zee Bangla. It stars Shinjinee Chakraborty and Neel Bhattacharya in the lead roles. Initially it scored very well in TRP charts but later its popularity declined and it was replaced by Jagaddhatri. It was premiered on 13 September 2021. The series is produced by Tent Cinema.
plot: The story revolves around Uma who dreams of becoming a cricketer but is forced to give up on her dream due to familial obligations. However, her passion for the game and her husband Abhimanyu's constant motivation push her to realize her ambition and start playing cricket again.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Shinjinee Chakraborty as Uma Acharya (née Das) - a cricketer, Abhi's wife, Aliya's former assistant, Sunanda and Sutapa's daughter, Soma's younger sister and Chumki's elder sister * Neel Bhattacharya as Abhimanyu Acharya aka Abhi - a social worker and helper, Uma's husband, Aliya's former fiancé, Amrita and Ambarish's son, Anurag and Rikhiya's younger brother and Ishita's brother-in-law

title: Unoloukik
summary:
Unoloukik (Bengali: ঊনলৌকিক) is a Bangladeshi anthology streaming television series written by Shibabrata Barman and directed by Robiul Alam Robi. Individual episodes explore the psychoanalytic journey of the human mind. There are five episodes in this series. The first episode, Moribar Holo Taar Shwaad, premiered on 12 July 2021, and the last episode, Dwikhondito, on 12 August 2021 on OTT platform Chorki.
The series has adopted four stories by Shibabrata Barman - Moribar Holo Tar Shwaad, Dwikhondito, Jagar Bela Holo (adapted to Mrs. Prohelika), and Television (adapted to Hello Ladies). And he wrote the fifth story Don't Write Me especially for this series.
Unoloukik has been produced under the banner of Film Noir and Film Syndicate. Saleh Sobhan Auneem served as the producer and Mir Mukarram Hossain, Tanim Noor, Rumel Chowdhury were the executive producers.
The screenwriting team consists of Neamoth Ullah Masum, Syed Ahmed Shawki, and Naseef Amin along with Shibabrata Barman and Robiul Alam Robi.
Five cinematographers worked on the five episodes of Unoloukik, which is a rare feat in the Bangladeshi entertainment industry. They are - Kamrul Hasan Khosru, Tanveer Ahmed Shovon, Sumon Sarker, Ishtiaque Hossain, and Barkat Hossain Polash.
The cast includes Asaduzzaman Noor, Gazi Rakayet, Chanchal Chowdhury, Nusrat Imrose Tisha, Rafiath Rashid Mithila, Iresh Zaker,  Intekhab Dinar, Mostafa Monwar, Sumon Anwar, Naziba Basher,  Shohel Mondol, Farhana Hamid, and Sahana Rahman Sumi.

articleSections.title: Genre and themes
articleSections.text: As Unoloukik is an anthology series, each episode is standalone and can be watched in any order. The program is an instance of Psychological fiction within thriller and drama. The majority of the episodes revolve around the maze of illusion and truth. Each of the stories has its dark materials present time and space paradoxes and questions pertaining to existence. There are historical testaments, psychological bewilderments, and an overall curious expedition of what might have been true if only a combination was altered.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: On 26 June 2021, Chorki released the poster of Unoloukik on social media. And on 10 July 2021, they released the trailer on YouTube. Unoloukik premiered on 12 July 2021, with an episode release. One episode would be released every week for the remainder of the 5-episode first season. The last episode Dwikhondito aired on 12 August 2021.

title: Udaariyaan
summary: Udaariyaan (transl. Flight of Dreams) is an Indian Hindi-language television romantic drama series. It aired from 15 March 2021 to 24 July 2024 on Colors TV and streams on JioCinema. Produced by Sargun Mehta and Ravi Dubey, this show is the seventh longest running television shows of Colors TV. It starred Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, Isha Malviya, Ankit Gupta, Twinkle Arora, Hitesh Bharadwaj, Aditi Bhagat, Anuraj Chahal, Alisha Parveen, Avinesh Rekhi, and Shreya Jain over four generations.
plot:
Jasmine and Tejo Sandhu are sisters from Moga. While Jasmine dreams of settling in Canada, Tejo wants to remain in Punjab. Fateh Singh Virk is a boxer who is in love with Jasmine. They pursue a relationship but Jasmine refuses to marry Fateh when she learns that he has lost his job. Tejo and Fateh marry to save the family's reputation. Fateh does not want to move on and continues to romance Jasmine.
Tejo is heartbroken when she discovers the truth. When Fateh and Tejo start falling for each other, Jasmine plots against them. She marries Fateh's brother, Amrik, by mistake. However, due to Amrik's love and care for her, Jasmine also falls for him. Tejo's former fiancé, Angad, sets Tejo on fire and everyone presumes her to be dead.
During their trip to London, Jasmine and Amrik meet Tejo's lookalike, Tanya, who is assigned to investigate Tejo's murder. Amrik dies while saving Tanya from Angad, who is later jailed for his crimes. Jasmine is revealed to be pregnant. Tanya finds Tejo and reunites her with Fateh. Jasmine miscarries but leaves an orphan at the hospital, claiming it to be her and Amrik's child. Tejo and Fateh learn the truth but raise the girl, naming her Nehmat. Jasmine moves to Canada and marries Yash.
Jasmine returns to India with her daughter Naaz after suffering domestic violence at the hands of Yash and his mother. Nehmat learns she is adopted, but believes that she is Jasmine and Amrik's daughter. Jasmine leaves Naaz with the Sandhus. Nehmat and Naaz bond with one another. Tejo, Fateh and the Virks die in a car accident.
Nehmat and Naaz are raised by the Sandhus. Nehmat is in love with Ekam, a trainee IPS officer. Meanwhile, Naaz suffers from an inferiority complex due to all the attention Nehmat receives. Naaz pressures Nehmat to marry Advait Kapoor so she can marry his younger brother, Nikhil Kapoor. Jasmine returns and it is revealed that Jasmine and Advait's father were behind the accident that killed Tejo, Fateh and the Virks. Nehmat's marriage to Advait is nullified as Jasmine's daughter, Harleen, is revealed to be Advait's legal wife. Advait tries to kill Harleen but is jailed. Harleen falls for Ekam. Ekam and Nehmat decide to marry but she backs out after being blackmailed by Jasmine. Ekam and Harleen then marry.
Nehmat realises that she is pregnant with Ekam's child. She gives birth to a daughter, but Harleen kidnaps her. Nehmat is told that her child was born dead while Harleen and Ekam name the child Aliya.
Aliya meets Nehmat at a summer camp and they bond. Eventually, Ekam and Nehmat discover the truth and confront Harleen. Nehmat tells Ekam and Harleen's marriage is null and void, as Ekam and Nehmat got already married in Gurudwara, before Jasmine plotted to separate then to get Ekam and Harleen marry. Jasmine and Harleen decide to plot an accident for Nehmat in which Harleen is presumed to be dead. Nehmat finds evidence against Jasmine and get her jailed.
Ekam forcefully marries Nehmat and eventually both again fall in love with each other but Harleen returns and plots against the two. Nehmat and Ekam deport her back to Canada after finding out the truth. On seeing this, Aliya begins to hate Nehmat and Ekam. Harleen is revealed to be pregnant with Ekam's child through IVF.
A grown up Aliya wants to go to Canada to meet Harleen. She is in love with Armaan. Harleen is now married to Deepak Dhillon and her daughter with Ekam, Asma, returns to India. She keeps meeting Armaan and their marriage is fixed. The two marry unwillingly. Aliya grows jealous and vengeful. Asma and Armaan start to fall for each other, but the former discovers his relationship with Aliya. Aasma is hurt but agrees to divorce Armaan. Armaan ends his relationship with Aliya and reveals his feelings for Asma. Aliya marries Raja but continues to plot.
Aliya tries to murder Asma, but Asma ends up in an enemy country instead. Believing that she is dead, Armaan marries Aliya, who is pregnant with Raja's child. Armaan saves Asma and brings her back to India. Armaan and Aasma adopt Zaid while Aliya gives birth to a daughter, Khushi. Asma is revealed to be pregnant and Aliya hires goons to get rid of her, which leads to Aasma going into early labor. She gives birth to twin girls but is made to believe that one of her daughters died during birth. The goons throw the girl in the river, but she is saved by Armaan.
Asma is living with her daughter, Haniya, and Zaid. Armaan is raising Meher, unaware that she is his and Asma's daughter. Aliya wants to eliminate Meher to get Armaan. Armaan and Asma come face to face and Aliya is exposed and arrested. The police jeep has an accident and Aliya becomes paralyzed. After the accident, Aliya turns over a new leaf and apologizes to Asma for her misdeeds.
Ranvijay Singh, aka Rockstar RV, is introduced. Aliya and RV fall in love, but Aliya remains faithful to Raja. In a twist of events, RV turns out to be Sukhi's illegitimate son. Sukhi promises to have Aliya and RV marry as Raja is mentally unstable. However, Asma stops the wedding, and RV leaves the Gill house. Aliya turns negative again and tortures Aasma. She kidnaps Haniya and Meher, but Asma rescues them. It becomes known that Meher is Armaan and Asma's daughter. In a last-ditch effort, Aliya tries to kill Asma but ends up falling to her death.
Meher and Haniya have grown up to be opposites. Meher is disillusioned by love because she believes that Armaan faked his love for Aasma and left them all. Haniya has fallen for Sarab, but Sarab sees Meher as his ideal type. However, due to Meher's rude behavior, he clashes with her.
Haniya tries to talk to Meher and Aasma about her love but is unable to. Asma decides to have Meher and Sarab marry as she thinks only Sarab can handle Meher's attitude. After many misunderstandings, Meher finally accepts to marry Sarab, and Sarab also confesses his love. Meher also eventually confesses her love. Munni, who was insulted by Meher in front of everyone, tries to turn Meher against Haniya. Haniya confesses to Meher that she used to love Sarab, which divides the sisters.
Meher decides to have Haniya marry Vikram to make sure she stays away from Sarab. Vikram is revealed to be Shakti's younger brother who wants to retaliate against Meher and Haniya. Vikram and Shakti's truth is revealed on the wedding day and the two sisters reunite. However, Munni has Meher kidnapped and pretends that Meher fled from her wedding. Haniya is forced to marry Sarab for her family's honor.
Meher begins to despise Haniya and believes Haniya plotted everything to get Sarab. Meher fixates on reuniting with Sarab and threatens suicide if Sarab doesn't divorce Haniya. Haniya realises Munni is in cahoots with Shakti and decides to expose her. However, Munni outsmarts Haniya and blames everything on her. Haniya begs Meher to trust her, so Meher gives her a chance to prove her innocence. Once Munni's truth is exposed to Meher as well, the sisters join hands to expose Munni.
Munni's truth is exposed in front of everyone and Haniya is proven innocent. Munni is forgiven after she realizes the wrongs of her ways. Meher, realizing that Haniya's love for her and Sarab is pure and selfless, accepts Sarab and Haniya's marriage. Then the family reunites.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, Isha Malviya and Ankit Gupta were cast to portray the leads Tejo, Jasmine and Fateh respectively. Post the six month leap, Choudhary also played Tanya. Karan Grover was roped in as the main antagonist and played the dual roles of Angad and Arjun.
In September 2022, the series took a generation leap when Twinkle Arora, Hitesh Bharadwaj and Sonakshi Batra were cast as Nehmat, Ekam and Naaz respectively. Malviya returned in the dual role of an older Jasmine and her daughter Harleen. In April 2023, Rohit Purohit quit the show. In the same month, Kushagre Dua enters the show as Joginder Singh. In late April 2023, Vivian Dsena joined the show as Dr. Sartaj Singh Randhawa. In late June 2023, Sonakshi Batra quit the show. In mid-July 2023, Dsena also quit the show. In August 2023, Arora and Bharadwaj also quit the series.
In August 2023, the series took another generation leap when Aditi Bhagat, Anuraj Chahal and Alisha Parveen Khan were cast as Aasma, Armaan and Aliya respectively. In April 2024, Kunal Karan Kapoor was cast as the parallel lead Ranvijay, opposite Aliya.
In May 2024, the series took another generation leap when Aditi Bhagat, Avinesh Rekhi and Shreya Jain were cast as Haniya, Sarabjeet and Meher respectively.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The series has been shot in Chandigarh since its inception. During the six months leap track, the series was shot in London.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: A special song promo was released with Sargun Mehta, Choudhary, Gupta and Isha Malviya alongside rapper Badshah.

articleSections.title: Crossover
articleSections.text: Udaariyaan had a crossover with Choti Sarrdaarni from 19 April 2021 to 20 April 2021, where Tejo and Sarab met. * It hosted a Bollywood themed Diwali bash in November 2021, which was attended by the cast of Colors TV's shows along with Gurpreet Ghuggi, Gippy Grewal and Gurnam Bhullar.
